title: Fiori: complex object continuity
summary: Keep parent and child identity stable while separating item Apply from parent Save, preserving drafts through interruption and linked correction.
use_when: An operator moves between parent objects and their items, with distinct draft and commit boundaries that must survive interruption.
avoid_when: The layout is only a dashboard, unrelated side tools surround one object, or a single short form does not need a parent/item workflow.
